title: AMC 10 Practice: Geometric Sequences Ending at 144 — How Many?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on counting increasing geometric sequences of whole numbers that end at 144, solved with the ratio and with factors. (Level 4 of 5)
How many increasing geometric sequences of three whole numbers end at 144? Vantee shows two ways to find them all, with every trap explained.
Pause the video and try it first, then try the ending-at-72 challenge!
